title: Welcome email
summary: Emails every new person a short, friendly welcome the moment they sign up.
description: Fires when a row is added to the table your people sign up into (the persona's own table). The email goes to that person's email field, uses their name, and is sent from your app with its branded wrapper. Edit the subject and body to sound like you.

params.name: person
params.label: Who signs up
params.description: The table a new person lands in when they sign up (usually named after the role, like customer or member).

params.name: email_field
params.label: Their email field
params.description: The email field on that table the welcome goes to.

notes: A table for the people who sign up, with an email field.

includes: One workflow: on signup, email the new person
